text:
As a professional writing, I have helped thousands of people move from the house where most of their lives have passed to a smaller one to enjoy their last years. Get the correct size reduction and can launch the next exciting chapter. But do it badly and can leave you regret and fight to move on. Here are the ingredients for the success I have learned.
The time to start your planning is right now Realistically, there may be only a handful of properties that would adjust to its ideal size. Most people tend to remain in the same area and, within that, few will be appropriate. If you have identified them very much, you can jump when they come to the market.
One of my clients only had one property in his town to which he could imagine the reduction of personnel, and when he was finally available, he was ready to start.
I have met customers to put notes through the doors of the houses where they would like to move eventually, asking the owners that when they want to sell they should contact, even if it’s years.
Meirion Shaw is a professional writing, which has helped thousands of people move from the house where most of their lives have passed to a smaller one to enjoy their last years.
Get a complete survey in your home and fix everything that is broken Long before planning to reduce the size, conduct a survey of your own home.
It may think that this is crazy; After all, potential buyers will carry out their own surveys. But if you have lived in your home for decades, there is a good possibility that you have problems that maintain a sale.
He had a partner who discovered in his survey that the ceiling of his 40 -year -old needed to be replaced. Due to the state of this, potential buyers would have fought to obtain a house mortgage.
But because they had done a well in advance, they had time to solve it. And when they finally put the house on the market, there were no problems.
Another client had a survey and discovered that part of his garden belonged officially to his neighbor. While they had legitimately bought the small strip of land decades ago, the facts had never changed. That would have wreaked havoc in a potential sale, but they learned of time and could correct the records.
You never know what will trigger you to reduce size. It could be the cleaner that has had retirees or the garden or stairs become too much. Prepare for that day.
Find a new home that has its own wow factor People often fight to reduce size because much of their social congratulations come from their home.
So many years have passed the properties that show their success that moving to a smaller place can be difficult.
So find a new home that is impressive in its own way.
That could mean progress more towards the city, where it is seconds from stores and coffee shops.
I helped a widow, Anne, to reduce last year from a five -bedroom house to an apartment with the most beautifully maintained community garden. He even had a small maze for his grandchildren to play. A lot to impress friends when they visit.
Meirion Shaw helps Ray and Janet Annetis reduce their new apartment
Get a stranger to help administer your family As professional descending, one of the most important roles we make my team and I is mediating.
Even the most pleasant families can become unpleasant when money is involved, but having a stranger can help keep everyone with good behavior.
Before the move is carried out, we help the bass to build a digital inventory of their possessions. We tag everything where they are going, what they are carrying with them and what they plan to get rid of.
Then they can share this with family members who can say what they would like, either now or later.
This process has the additional advantage of facilitating the line of the line.
If tensions arise, we can classify them instead of the bass, which have enough in their hands. Sometimes, obtaining allegedly expensive items can cool disputes.
When clearing, keep the best for you The bass often have plates that use every day and a set that were given on their wedding day they bring for special occasions. As they can generally take only one set, I always suggest that they opt for the best of themselves.
They are often surprised, saying: “Surely we can’t use elegant plates for every day?” But then they love it.
So what happens if a bit of Gold Rim fades? Dinner services are not worth so much and can also enjoy yours.

Establish how much space will have To solve how many things you can take, plan the storage in advance.
If you know you will have only a river of clothing, then you can measure it and plan to take only what you will fit. You can do the same with books, cooking articles: the lot.
Then, when you move, you will have a home for everything.
Refrain from putting something in storage In our experience, you will never get it again.
My only exception was for a client with severe dementia that had a wonderful hat collection that I had used for Ascot over the years. She loved everyone but had no room for them.
We put them in storage and every week his daughter took one and gave it to her mother to admire and enjoy.
At the end of the week, the daughter would leave the hat in a charity store.
His mother was not well enough to remember the hats that had gone, but still received joy from each one.
Children may be willing to help … but they can’t You may have wonderful adult children who would love to help you reduce size, but most have occupied families and lives and not have time.
The descending are as substitute daughters, helping where an adult child would do it if he had time or live nearby.
I started my business, the Homemaver specialist, in 2012, after seeing first -hand that the difference can make adequate practical and emotional support.
My mother -in -law and my godmother were reduced at the same time, but due to logistics, I could only help my mother -in -law. He was ready for his next adventure, while my godmother was exhausted physically and emotionally.
Like low, we help from beginning to end, from finding a property to classify your belongings, to unpacking and configuring broadband.
As their future changes happen in their history The bass often have photo batteries of family members that younger generations could not identify. There are excellent services now that can digitize these memories.
We help a couple go through albums and choose all the aunts and lost cousins ​​a long time ago. Then they put them all in a single album for their children, so they had a record of their family history.
Look well your marriage Couples who have got along their entire married life can fight when they are reduced.
The greatest tension is often to move from a TV to share one. Couples should adjust to live almost independent lives in a large house to share a smaller space.
A couple reducing a two -bed floor planned to have a guest room. The husband clearly spent most of his time in his study, so I suggested to turn the free room into a bedroom/studio, and saved the future anguish.
Low often have lots of photos of family members that younger generations cannot identify
The right one for your belongings It is easier to put aside the belongings you appreciate if you find them a good home.
We helped a gentleman who could not get rid of the Teddies who were once loved by their children. But when we found a beneficial organization that distributed them to children who had none, I was happy to let them go.
Think before moving with your family We often see that people reduce their adult or daughter annex, to miles from their old house.
They can become alone because they do not have a broader social network, and things can be tense when they depend on their son or daughter to leave.
The son thinks: “What is the problem? They eat with us a couple of nights a week and come for Sunday lunch”, but the older father quickly loses his old life and wishes that they have not moved.
Leaving your beautiful chairs Last year I helped a couple reduce the size that they were determined to bring their beautiful sofa and matching chairs.
But when I went to his house, I saw that they never used them, they were difficult to enter and leave and preferred to use those used. If you don’t fit your life, don’t take it.
Last year I helped a couple reduce the size that they were determined to bring their beautiful sofa and matching chairs. But when I went home, I saw that they never used them
Problems to move to a floor I see that the health of the bass deteriorates when they move from a house with stairs to a floor in a floor. If you don’t use it, you lose it, so make sure you don’t take the elevator all the time and walk to stores instead of taking the bus or driving.
Out with the old man and with the new When you get rid of so much, it can be contradictory to buy something new. But sometimes what you have does not fit your new life. A couple who moved to a care house bought new furniture to adapt to their new space: he looked great and excited them even more to move.
Get help through your things Deciding what to maintain or get rid of it can be overwhelming.
But having a stranger to do it, who wants the best for you but does not have an emotional bond in your belongings, can facilitate work. Sometimes, the best way to solve what to maintain is to tell another person for their reasoning. Saying it out loud is enough to help you realize what you really want to do.
Making an effort to see both sides If you are helping someone reduce size, you can help understand where your attitudes come from.
For example, we find that it is easy for younger generations to frustrate with family members in their 80s fighting things. But it can help remember that they were born during the war, when they were taught “waste does not want.”
The writing is not for everyone I know an old woman who wanted to leave her home larger, but was at the center of her community, a member of the choir and other groups. For her, it made more sense to adapt her home than to leave. Today, she is the first person to invite new neighbors to welcome them.
